capabilities: Stream Music For Programming episodes as an auto-advancing playlist in the sidebar
Resume each episode's playback position across Obsidian restarts
Mark episodes as favourites and switch to a favourites-only playlist
Refresh the official RSS feed for new episodes on demand
Control playback with commands, hotkeys, media keys or the status bar
extras: Unofficial fan-made plugin with the site owner's permission, not affiliated with Music For Programming or Datassette; requires internet to fetch the feed and stream MP3s (nothing is downloaded); desktop-only because mobile background audio is unreliable; includes a donation link for the series and for the author; code licensed GNU AGPL v3.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play a long-running external audio series in the sidebar while working, with playback position remembered between sessions.

relations.evidence: It fetches the public RSS feed from musicforprogramming.net on first run, and when you press [refresh].

summary: Sidebar music player that streams the Music For Programming mix series with resume, favourites, themes and an ASCII equalizer.
